pooled.scope: Descriptive pooled two-round AB/BA statistics only. Not a contiguous, identically ordered ABBA: pilot runs budget before prefill/C8; reverse starts with prefill, and other tests separate rounds. Startup, prior activity and thermal/cache state can differ; do not infer causal certainty or a confidence interval.
